title: User-triggered motion animation and vestibular disorder symptoms
statement:
Motion animation triggered by user interaction can trigger nausea or dizziness in users with vestibular disorders, requiring an option to disable non-essential motion.

Options:
- OS-Level Respect: Query @media (prefers-reduced-motion) (fits: all websites, compliance standards)
- Vestibular-Safe Fallback: Replace movement with crossfade (fits: page routing, modal opens)
- High Vestibular Risk: High-velocity parallax (fits: use only if opt in)
appliesWhen: Applies to: parallax effects, scroll animations, page transitions. Audience: general.
